$comment: Which producer emits, which reader folds, and which host handles each part of contracts/agent/juno-agent-protocol-v1.json. Checked by scripts/generate-agent-protocol.mjs: every event and command must be classified for every party listed, and nothing may be classified that the contract does not have. implemented: it does this today, and a test covers it. planned: it means to; the note says what stands in the way. n/a: it never will, by design; the note says why.

cloud-runner.summary: scripts/cloud-code-runner.mjs, through runner/agent-core/src/protocol-projector.ts (AgentEvent → protocol). Posted as `protocol` task events to a server that advertises agentProtocol in runner-context.

session.configured.note: A cloud run's model, effort and mode are fixed at dispatch; session.created carries them.

turn.interrupted.note: A cancel between steps, and a run the driver abandons on an exception.

transcript.restarted.note: A cloud run is one pass; nothing rewinds it.

item.tool_output.note: agent-core returns a command's output with its result; it has no streaming output event yet.

item.file_change.note: From the staged diff after the agent phase, as the legacy file_change rows are.

item.test_run.note: agent-core has no test runner tool; test commands arrive as bash calls with an exit code.

item.compaction.note: agent-core has no compaction yet (audit C3); it lands with the engine lane.

approval.resolved.note: Always by `mode`: nobody is attached to a cloud run, so the permission mode answers and says so.

question.asked.note: Cloud Code has no ask-the-user tool; cloud Work's askQuestion joins in slice 3.

plan.updated.note: Cloud Work's update_plan joins in slice 3; cloud Code has no todo tool.

plan.proposed.note: Plan → approve → Code is a runtime-lane feature.

usage.updated.note: Per turn from turn_finished, and per sub-agent. Cache counts ride along once agent-core reports them.

mac-host.summary: The Mac, through JunoCodeBridge's AgentProtocolProjection (SessionEvent → protocol). Carried on relay uploads (payload key `protocol`) and posted as `protocol` task events for device tasks whose server advertises agentProtocol.

turn.started.note: A user prompt opens a turn; its turnId is derived from the prompt's sequence.

turn.failed.note: The Swift runtime records a failure as an error plus a failed status; session.error and session.state carry it until it records the turn's end as one event.

item.assistant_text.delta.note: The Swift runtime journals whole replies.

item.thinking.delta.note: The Swift runtime journals reasoning summaries whole.

approval.resolved.note: The Swift journal records approved or denied; always-allow and redirect are not distinguished in it yet, so they read as allow_once and deny.

question.asked.note: No ask_user tool in the Swift runtime yet (runtime lane).

plan.proposed.note: Plan → approve → Code is a runtime-lane feature.

usage.updated.note: The Swift journal does not record per-call usage (audit C6); sub-agent usage rides item.subagent.

code.pull_request.note: A Mac session does not open pull requests on its own.

web-fold.summary: src/lib/agent-protocol/fold.ts: the web's transcript and the server's persisted outcome read a task through it, with upgradeLegacy for events stored before the protocol.

swift-fold.summary: JunoAgentProtocol's AgentSessionFold: the same reducer in Swift, held to the same golden fixtures.

mac-host.summary: No host accepts protocol commands yet: commands are slice 2. Each note names the legacy verb that carries the intent today.

turn.send.note: Slice 2. Today: `message` relay command; a queued CodeTask for a device run.

turn.steer.note: Slice 2. Today: `steer` task control; relay `message` with delivery steer.

turn.queue.note: Slice 2. Today: relay `message` with delivery queue.

cloud-runner.summary: As mac-host. The runner reads legacy task controls from the events POST response.

turn.send.note: Slice 2. Today: `message` relay command; a queued CodeTask for a device run.

turn.steer.note: Slice 2. Today: `steer` task control; relay `message` with delivery steer.

turn.queue.note: Slice 2. Today: relay `message` with delivery queue. Cloud runs take a message sent mid-run as a steer.

question.answer.note: Slice 2. Today: nothing yet. Cloud Code has no question tool.

plan.decide.note: Slice 2. Today: nothing yet. Cloud Code has no plan mode.

session.set_mode.note: Slice 2. Today: relay `patch` (update_session). A cloud run's mode is fixed at dispatch.
